description: Request an order from a buyer-approved production quote. Live order creation is currently closed: this tool returns the stable error code ordering_not_open and recommends submit_inquiry until settlement and fulfillment are enabled. It never charges the buyer while closed.

agent.description: Optional agent identity retained for supplier communication and audit.

callbackUrl.description: Optional HTTPS callback URL for fulfillment events.

buyer.description: Buyer identity used for order records and supplier communication.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key reused on retries to prevent duplicate order creation.

quoteId.description: Production quote ID beginning with q_; it must be current and explicitly approved by the buyer.

name: create_order

outputSchema.description: Order result, a structured ordering-disabled response, or null when the quote is not found.

error.description: Stable error code, such as ordering_not_open.
